acceptance_gate: The pseudo-expectation theorem, the degree corollary and the size theorem are proved in prose; check.py verifies the pseudo-expectation exactly (ideal constraints for three encodings, Sherali-Adams nonnegativity, moment-matrix positivity by exact LDL) at degree cvw-1 on declared graphs, including restricted ones, with a broken-tangle control.
objective: Prove: (1) a tangle of order k of the cut function gives a pseudo-expectation for Tseitin up to degree k-1 that defeats Sherali-Adams and sum-of-squares refutations in the clause, standard binomial and balanced binomial encodings, with or without twin variables; hence SoS and SA degree are at least the carving width, and SoS degree is at most cvw + 4 when cvw >= 2 Delta (Berkholz's simulation and PC-DEGREE). (2) On graphs with a cell system, SoS and SA size is 2^Omega(tangle order), so 2^Theta(tw) on grids, d-dimensional grids, plane graphs with short faces and walls. Check the pseudo-expectation exactly on declared instances, including restricted ones.
status: Proved by SOS-SIZE-20261020-001B-P001 (prose, with cited tangle duality, Berkholz's SoS simulation of PC, Atserias-Dalmau): a tangle of order k gives a pseudo-expectation for Tseitin up to degree k-1 that defeats Sherali-Adams and sum-of-squares (clause and standard encodings; balanced when every degree is below k, needed by a hub example); SoS degree is between cvw and cvw+4 when cvw >= 2 Delta - 2, SA degree between cvw and floor(3 cvw/2)+1; with cell restrictions, SoS and SA size is 2^Theta(tw) on grids, d-dimensional grids, plane short-face graphs and walls; with twin variables also 2^Omega_H(tw) on minor-free graphs and 2^Omega(tw^(1/9)/polylog) on all graphs. Checks pass on 15 graphs with exact positivity certificates.
stop_rule: Stop and record the gap if any check of the pseudo-expectation fails on a declared instance.
title: Proof: tangles give SoS and Sherali-Adams pseudo-expectations; size on graphs with cell systems
